name: chip-contract
description: Teaches your agent the chip lifecycle: deciding whether a behavior should be a chip at all, authoring the package, building the fixture suite that gates its authority, installing it so it actually resolves, auditing for the silent failures, and closing the outcome loop so the chip can be calibrated rather than merely evaluated. Eight skills over the contract in spec 0.6, including chip-socket: seating an existing function's code-or-model decision in a socket so the escalation band is learned from receipts.
